title: Homeodomain protein Sxi1alpha independently controls cell-cell fusion and gene expression during sexual reproduction in Cryptococcus deneoformans.
authors: Huang, Jun; Lehmann, Anna E; Peterson, Patricia P; Xu, Ziyan; Xiong, Liping; Sun, Sheng; Heitman, Joseph
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌HD转录因子Sxi1alpha在隐球菌有性生殖中调控细胞融合与基因表达，虽用AlphaFold3预测蛋白结构但未聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，属广义蛋白-DNA相关转录调控，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: Sex-specific homeodomain (HD) proteins are key regulators of cell identity and sexual development in fungi, typically functioning as heterodimers to govern transcription. In the human fungal pathogens Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus deneoformans, the HD proteins Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a (Sex-inducer 1alpha and 2a) have been characterized as interacting components that play critical roles in sexual development during alpha x a sexual reproduction. alpha cells are the predominant mating type in natural populations of Cryptococcus, and unisexual (same-sex) mating can also occur in certain genetic backgrounds. The roles of Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a in unisexual reproduction are not fully understood. To elucidate the functions of Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a in unisexual reproduction and downstream transcriptional regulation, we first applied AlphaFold3 to predict their structures, which revealed the potential for both heterodimeric and homodimeric complexes. We subsequently deleted SXI1alpha and SXI2 a in the hyper-filamentous self-fertile C. deneoformans strains XL280alpha and XL280a. Disruption of these genes did not result in noticeable defects in vegetative growth, virulence-associated traits, colony morphology, sporulation, or competitiveness during unisexual crosses. Interestingly, both bilateral (mutant x mutant) and unilateral (mutant x wildtype) crosses involving the sxi1alphaDelta mutant significantly increased alpha-alpha cell fusion efficiency, suggesting a previously unrecognized inhibitory role for Sxi1alpha in regulating same-sex cell fusion. Transcriptomic analysis of sxi1alphaDelta and sxi2 aDelta mutants led to the identification of unique subsets of genes negatively regulated by each transcription factor during unisexual reproduction. Additionally, alpha x a crosses between deletion mutants for SXI1alpha, SXI2 a, or both revealed differential regulation of mating-type (MAT) loci genes dependent only on SXI1alpha or SXI2 a. Together, our findings revealed an unexpected function of Sxi1alpha in regulating cell fusion, highlighting the versatile roles of HD transcription factors in fungal sexual reproduction. Additionally, our data suggest that SXI1alpha and SXI2 a have distinct regulatory roles in both unisexual and alpha x a sexual reproduction and may function as homodimeric complexes to exert opposing regulatory effects on sex-specific MAT genes.
abstract_zh: 性别特异性同源结构域（homeodomain, HD）蛋白是真菌中细胞身份和性别发育的关键调控因子，通常以异源二聚体形式发挥转录调控作用。在人类病原真菌新生隐球菌（Cryptococcus neoformans）和格特隐球菌（Cryptococcus deneoformans）中，HD蛋白Sxi1α和Sxi2a（性别诱导因子1α和2a）已被表征为相互作用组分，在α×a有性生殖过程中的性别发育中发挥关键作用。α细胞是隐球菌自然群体中的主要交配型，且在某些遗传背景下也可发生单性（同性别）交配。Sxi1α和Sxi2a在单性生殖中的作用尚未完全阐明。为揭示Sxi1α和Sxi2a在单性生殖及下游转录调控中的功能，我们首先应用AlphaFold3预测其结构，结果显示其具有形成异源二聚体和同源二聚体复合物的潜力。随后，我们在高丝状自育性C. deneoformans菌株XL280α和XL280a中敲除了SXI1α和SXI2a。这些基因的破坏未导致营养生长、毒力相关性状、菌落形态、产孢或单性杂交竞争性方面的明显缺陷。有趣的是，涉及sxi1αΔ突变体的双边（突变体×突变体）和单边（突变体×野生型）杂交均显著提高了α-α细胞融合效率，提示Sxi1α在调控同性别细胞融合中具有此前未被识别的抑制作用。对sxi1αΔ和sxi2aΔ突变体的转录组分析鉴定出每个转录因子在单性生殖过程中负调控的独特基因亚群。此外，SXI1α、SXI2a或两者缺失突变体之间的α×a杂交显示，交配型（mating-type, MAT）位点基因的差异调控仅依赖于SXI1α或SXI2a。综合来看，我们的发现揭示了Sxi1α在调控细胞融合中的意外功能，凸显了HD转录因子在真菌有性生殖中的多功能角色。此外，我们的数据表明，SXI1α和SXI2a在单性及α×a有性生殖中具有不同的调控作用，并可能以同源二聚体复合物形式对性别特异性MAT基因施加相反的调控效应。
